title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders Fulfillment Fee Schedule
content:
**Pricing & Promotions schedule. Applies to every Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders purchase, by fulfillment method.**

The fulfillment fee is the shipping, delivery or freight fee assessed on an order. The figures below are set per fulfillment method; the free-shipping order threshold itself belongs to the customer's Pals Rewards tier and is not set by this schedule.

## Schedule

| Fulfillment method | Fulfillment fee (customer whose tier threshold is not met) | Fee waived when the merchandise subtotal reaches the Pals Rewards free-shipping threshold | Fee charged to a customer with an active Tailwise Plus tier | Minimum merchandise subtotal for the method to be offered | Fulfillment fee refunded when the whole order is cancelled before fulfillment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Ship-to-Home | $5.99 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Expedited Ship-to-Home | $14.99 | No | $7.99 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Buy Online Pick Up In Store | $0.00 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Curbside Pickup | $0.00 | Yes | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Same-Day Delivery | $9.99 | No | $4.99 | $35.00 | Yes |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | $79.00 | No | $79.00 | $0.00 | Yes |

## Column definitions

- **Fulfillment fee** - the shipping, delivery or freight fee per order for a customer whose tier threshold is not met, in USD.
- **Fee waived at the threshold** - whether the order's fulfillment fee is waived when the merchandise subtotal reaches the free-shipping order threshold of the customer's Pals Rewards tier.
- **Tailwise Plus fee** - the fulfillment fee charged in its place to a customer with an active Tailwise Plus tier, in USD.
- **Minimum merchandise subtotal** - the smallest merchandise subtotal for which the method is offered, in USD.
- **Refunded on full cancellation** - whether the fulfillment fee is refunded when the whole order is cancelled before fulfillment.

## Reading the schedule

- Same-Day Delivery is the only method with a minimum merchandise subtotal above zero: $35.00.
- On Large Item Freight Delivery the Tailwise Plus fee and the fulfillment fee are the same figure, $79.00.
- The two pickup methods carry no fulfillment fee at all, whether or not a threshold is reached.
- Every method refunds its fulfillment fee when the whole order is cancelled before fulfillment.
